title: See America: Welcome to Montana
coreRelationships: The large, layered mountains dominate the upper half, providing a majestic backdrop.
The dense, textured forest forms a dark, undulating band across the middle ground, separating the mountains from the foreground.
The foreground features a flat, golden-yellow plain with three teepees and a lone horseback rider, creating a narrative focal point.
The deep blue sky at the top contrasts sharply with the lighter mountain peaks and the warm tones of the lower landscape.
The text block at the bottom anchors the composition and provides clear messaging.
reuseFormula: Recreate a stylized landscape poster using a limited, high-contrast color palette. Employ flat, un-gradated color blocks to depict iconic natural features (e.g., mountains, forests) and cultural elements (e.g., indigenous dwellings, figures). Ensure strong visual separation between background, midground, and foreground. Incorporate bold, sans-serif typography at the bottom for a clear message, maintaining a vintage travel poster aesthetic.
